why: Retrospective item 5 mixes celebrating the shared achievement with reporting how the work fared, so the boundary between finished-work celebration and after-the-fact reporting is the hardest to hold.

why.T3-017: The only concept is an ordinary Rizin matchup cross-post; it is the sub's usual subject, not a canvas or April Fools act.

why.T3-033: The concepts offer ideas for an r/place mark (pixel Edmund, PRIDE logo/NEVER DIES) and call the room to make them, without a chosen template or built work.

why.T3-002: Concepts directly invite/recruit placers and members to place for the blob (start placing pixels, keep recruiting new members, join the cause by growing the blob).
why.T3-044: Other concepts advertise the sub on the canvas and count membership growth (write r/greyblob name to drive membership/bring people, celebrating passing twenty members).

multiplacement_log.why_not_one: T3-002 carries the calls to place, but would not carry the advertising of the sub name on the canvas or counting newcomers/membership milestones.
multiplacement_log.why_this_one: C1157076 and C0944249 write/get the sub name to drive membership, and C0457587 counts new members, which satisfies T3-044's gate.
multiplacement_log.dispensable: Drop T3-044 if forced to one; the direct placing calls remain, but the advertising and membership-count aspect would be lost.

why.T3-004: The concepts settle the blob's recognizable look and lettering—hearts, banner, Greybow name, flair, Pusheen—including name placement as part of the design.

why.T3-073: The item is a retrospective account of what happened to the logo—fights, negotiations, survival, and result—so T3-073's reporting gate leads; other themes at the three-concept floor are listed in also_present: T3-043, T3-072, T3-031, T3-006.

why.T3-149: The item is organized around truces/ceasefires and peace with neighbours, so T3-149's truce gate leads; other themes at the three-concept floor are listed in also_present: T3-010, T3-011, T3-150.
